title: Soft RT shadows: blue-noise jitter + temporal accumulation (baseline)
purpose: Introduce softening and stability for mesh RT shadows with minimal cost.

steps.detail: Sample a blue-noise texture (existing STBN) or a small per-frame scramble to jitter the shadow ray within a narrow cone (1–2 degrees). Keep deterministic per-pixel sequence via frame index + pixel coord hashing.

Accumulate shadow visibility with a low-pass filter and clamp (e.g., vis_accum = clamp(mix(prev, curr, 0.1), prev-0.25, prev+0.25)). Store in an R8 or R16 target, or piggyback on an existing history channel.
Optionally interleave two directions per frame (even/odd frame) to double effective sample rate without doubling cost per frame.
Add a runtime toggle for softening and temporal accumulation; print once that soft shadows are active and the jitter cone angle used.

acceptance: Penumbrae appear and shimmer is reduced
Temporal behavior is stable over motion with minimal ghosting
notes: Keep one ray-query per fragment; compute jittered direction cheaply. Consider sRGB/linear consistency if storing visibility buffers.
